heading: Exclusive right to name
lead: The corporation and its State and local branches and subdivisions have the exclusive right to use the name “The American National Theater and Academy”.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2190436:3305.July 5, 1935, ch. 373, § 5, 49 Stat. 458. The word “sole” is omitted as included in “exclusive”. The words “to have” are omitted as included in “to use”. The words “in carrying out its purposes” are omitted as unnecessary.
